from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = set()
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for q in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    yy, xx = q
                    if 0 <= yy < rows and 0 <= xx < cols and q not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            objects.append([color, cells])

    # Let every shape slide right, with objects already farther right moving first.
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: max(c for r, c in obj[1]), reverse=True)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for i, (color, cells) in enumerate(objects):
            occupied = set().union(*(other_cells for j, (_, other_cells) in enumerate(objects) if j != i))
            if max(c for r, c in cells) + 1 < cols and all((r, c+1) not in occupied for r, c in cells):
                objects[i][1] = {(r, c+1) for r, c in cells}
                changed = True
    out = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for color, cells in objects:
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
